title: GenPFN: An In-Context Tabular Foundation Model Approach for Augmenting Small Datasets in Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.14804v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Costly simulations and experiments limit the data available for engineering design. This paper proposes GenPFN, a training-free candidate generator guided by a pretrained tabular Prior-Data Fitted Network (TabPFN) classifier with fixed weights. The context contains evaluated designs labeled desired (Class 1) or undesired (Class 0). GenPFN interpolates between desired designs and refines candidates using gated classifier gradients and Gaussian noise. Each candidate is evaluated using the problem's constraints and objective functions. Evaluated desired designs and their objective values augment the context for regression training.   Evaluation spans fourteen selected problems, including a two-parameter benchmark and a 44-parameter hull problem. translated_title: GenPFN：一种基于上下文表格基础模型的工程小数据集增强方法
translated_abstract: 昂贵的仿真与实验限制了工程设计可用的数据量。本文提出GenPFN，这是一种无需训练的候选设计生成器，由一个权重固定的预训练表格先验数据拟合网络分类器加以引导。上下文中包含已评估的设计，并被标注为期望（类别1）或不期望（类别0）。GenPFN在期望设计之间进行插值，并利用门控分类器梯度与高斯噪声来细化候选设计。每个候选设计均通过该问题的约束条件和目标函数进行评估。经过评估的期望设计及其目标值会扩充上下文，用于回归训练。评估涵盖十四个选定问题，包括一个双参数基准问题和一个44参数的船体设计问题。在成对比较中，结合TabPFN v1的GenPFN相比所测试的对抗生成器、变分自编码器和扩散生成器，取得了更高的类别满意度与更低的真实性距离。
tldr: GenPFN是一种由预训练表格基础模型TabPFN引导的免训练候选生成器，通过上下文学习对期望设计进行插值与细化，能在工程小数据集场景下生成比对抗、变分自编码器和扩散模型质量更高的设计候选。
en_tdlr: GenPFN is a training-free candidate generator guided by a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabPFN) that augments small engineering datasets by interpolating and refining desired designs in-context, producing higher-quality candidates than adversarial, VAE, and diffusion generators.
